title: Tributary
subtitle: Query Kafka topics from DuckDB.
intro: Read Kafka topic messages as rows with topic, partition, offset and BLOB payload columns. Discover cluster metadata, decode application payloads, and materialize a local table for joins and repeatable downstream analysis.

reference.name: tributary_scan_topic(topic, …)
reference.description: Read a topic as metadata columns and raw message bytes.

reference.name: tributary_metadata(…)
reference.description: Inspect broker and topic arrays without scanning a topic.

reference.name: "bootstrap.servers"
reference.description: Named parameter listing Kafka bootstrap host:port addresses.

reference.name: "group.id"
reference.description: Choose a dedicated consumer group for the analysis.

reference.name: "enable.auto.commit"
reference.description: Set to 'false' when analytics must not auto-commit offsets.

reference.name: "security.protocol"
reference.description: Configure PLAINTEXT, SSL or SASL transport for your broker.

notes.title: Read the payload deliberately
notes.body: Quote the offset column as "offset". message is a BLOB; decode(message) interprets UTF-8, and JSON extraction requires valid JSON payloads. Broker client options use quoted librdkafka names, including their dots.

notes.title: Plan the read
notes.body: Use a dedicated consumer group and restrict the topic, partition and offset range for ad-hoc work. This is a consumer interface; publishing belongs in a producer. Community package availability varies by DuckDB version and platform.

examples.title: Discover topics
examples.caption: Requires a compatible Tributary build and a Kafka broker on localhost:9092.
examples.reason: Requires compatible extension build and Kafka broker metadata access.

examples.title: Snapshot a partition range
examples.sql:
CREATE TABLE topic_snapshot AS
SELECT partition, "offset", message
FROM tributary_scan_topic('events',
  "bootstrap.servers" := 'localhost:9092',
  "group.id" := 'quick-reference',
  "enable.auto.commit" := 'false'
)
WHERE partition = 0
  AND "offset" BETWEEN 0 AND 99;
SELECT "offset",
       decode(message)::JSON->>'user_id' AS id
FROM topic_snapshot;
examples.caption: Assumes events contains UTF-8 JSON messages. Add broker authentication when required.
examples.reason: Requires Kafka topic access and consumes messages from the configured broker.
